purpose: Production-oriented starting dataset for a LangChain travel recommendation system and travel chatbot.
important_data_policy: Do not fabricate reviews, ratings, prices, weather, opening hours, coordinates or photos.
Static knowledge should be stored separately from live data.
Use live APIs/services for current weather, ratings, reviews, photos, opening hours and prices.
Every production answer should retain source provenance.
Candidate records must be enriched and verified before being treated as authoritative destination facts.

source_catalog.coverage: Official destination directory, national parks, experience taxonomy and trip-planning information.
